name: Tarfin
verdict: A private Turkish agritech platform founded in 2017. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Tarfin is the name and chest sponsor of Fenerbahce's basketball teams from 2026/27. Its own press release describes it as a technology platform started in 2017 offering forward-purchase (vadeli) trading in agriculture; the club announcement names its board (chairman Ali Emre Balli, vice chairman Yigit Gozubuyuk) - private founders and investors, no state or fund ownership found. The reported 7.5m euro/year fee plus up to 2.5m in bonuses is in data/deals/fenerbahce-basketball-tarfin-front.json.
